name: Survey tile in Libra
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Libra, imaged by SPHEREx 12 times in 4 visits over 26 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 23 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 26 hours starting 2025-07-08, at wavelengths from 1.25 to 4.57 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
